news.title: Man killed after fight outside DeKalb home, suspect arrested
news.summary: A man was shot and killed outside a DeKalb County home following an argument and fight late Thursday night, police said.

news.title: Man shot and killed at home in North Druid Hills area
news.summary: DeKalb County Police said they responded to a location on Fisher Trail late Thursday.

news.title: Inmate serving time for gang activity named as suspect in Norcross cold case, GBI says
news.summary: With the help of advanced DNA testing, authorities identified the suspect, who is already incarcerated on other unrelated charges.

news.title: Advanced DNA testing from Texas lab helps GBI solve man’s murder years later
news.summary: Tyler Hall was found dead in his home on Aug. 30, 2020. On Thursday, the GBI identified Rashad Jackson, of DeKalb County, as the suspect in Hall’s death.

news.title: Man caught with drugs also wanted for robbery, Atlanta police say
news.summary: An Atlanta police officer stopped a man after allegedly witnessing a drug transaction.

news.title: Motorcyclist sought after Stockbridge High vandalism
news.summary: Henry County police are searching for a motorcyclist accused of vandalizing property at Stockbridge High School.

news.title: Suspect arrested in shooting over bicycle in Clayton County
news.summary: Clayton County police have arrested a suspect in an August shooting that investigators say began with a confrontation over a bicycle.

news.title: Crash sends concrete barrier onto I-85 lanes in Gwinnett
news.summary: A crash involving a tractor-trailer sent pieces of a concrete barrier into the opposite side of Interstate 85 early Friday morning, according to Gwinnett County police.

news.title: Armed suspect surrenders after Rockdale County standoff, authorities say
news.summary: An armed suspect is in custody following a standoff where he barricaded himself inside a Rockdale County home with a disabled woman on Thursday afternoon, according to the sheriff's office.

news.title: More than $500K total stolen from 70+ students in flight school fraud case
news.summary: Dozens of new student pilots are coming forward to law enforcement as a financial theft investigation into a Peachtree City flight school expands.

news.title: Man shot in the head, another injured after shooting in northwest Atlanta, police say
news.summary: Police are investigating multiple scenes they believe are connected to the shooting.
